notes: Three original portrait concepts; no in-game assets replaced.
Initial full-body unclothed base generation was rejected by the image tool safety filter. The delivered prompts request nonsexual headshots instead.
Generated portraits include dark fabric around the shoulders. These are appearance/style concepts, not compliant unequipped full-body starting character assets.
Native outputs are 1024x1536 PNG portraits with dark backgrounds; transparency was not requested for the final portraits.

variants.label: Пепельный
variants.detail: Variation A / Ash: slightly elongated adult face with high angular cheekbones, slender straight nose, close-cropped dark ash-brown hair, muted light olive complexion, calm grey eyes, reserved watchful expression. Healthy and understated, no gauntness.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original adult human character PORTRAIT concept for the dark fantasy browser game Duelyant.
The three supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Reference 2 establishes gothic fantasy art direction, severe sculptural modelling and muted charcoal palette. Reference 1 informs warm aged highlights; reference 3 informs ivory tones, shadow depth and controlled detail. Do not copy their costumes, frames, skulls, beards, pointed ears or glowing eyes.
This is a tightly cropped HEADSHOT showing only the head, neck and very top of the shoulders; everything below the shoulders is OUTSIDE THE IMAGE. Ordinary neutral nonsexual character portrait. Adult human age 30–40 with androgynous facial features, no beard, normal human ears and eyes. Quiet serious expression. The subject is living and healthy, with organic warm skin texture, not a statue, corpse, elf or zombie.
Art direction: old gothic fantasy character portrait, richly textured illustrative surface with convincingly sculpted volumes, nuanced painterly modelling, sharp readable face, angular facial planes, deep near-black chiaroscuro and fine skin texture. Neither photograph nor glossy CGI. Restrained charcoal, ash, ivory and subdued earthy skin colors. A single directional upper front-left light reveals the forehead, nose and cheekbone, the far side of the face falls into rich deep readable shadow. No neon, no glowing eyes, no magical effects, no rim-light outline, no anime, no cartoon, no flat vector or low-poly planes.
Composition: vertical portrait preferably 1024x1536, close framing centered around face, head fully visible, eyes roughly 38 percent from top, top-of-shoulders cut at lower edge. Three-quarter face looking toward image right, still showing both eyes. Simple almost black charcoal background with only a very subtle cool tonal lift behind the head; no scenic environment, no frames, no text or watermark. No items, weapons, jewelry, ornaments, headgear or props. It should feel from the same cohesive portrait series as the other variants.
Variation A / Ash: slightly elongated adult face with high angular cheekbones, slender straight nose, close-cropped dark ash-brown hair, muted light olive complexion, calm grey eyes, reserved watchful expression. Healthy and understated, no gauntness.

variants.label: Земляной
variants.detail: Variation B / Earth: broad androgynous adult face, soft square jaw, blunt straight nose, closely shaved head, warm medium umber complexion, dark brown eyes, calm grounded expression. Subtle earthy bronze highlights on natural skin; no beard or masculine exaggeration.
